about: Baie-Comeau is a city on Quebec’s Côte-Nord, on the north shore of the St. Lawrence estuary at the mouth of the Manicouagan River region. Forestry, aluminum, and hydroelectric industry shaped its growth, with a working harbour and service role for the North Shore. Highway 138 is the coastal lifeline. About 21,000 people live in Baie-Comeau.
